answer.text: Mateo Silva participated in sequences contributing to advancing play and shot build-up, showing his passing connects to key moments even if not directly creating chances. For instance, at 64:07 to 64:22, Mateo's forward pass from the own half into the middle third helped advance play before a shot by Nico Vega went wide; the action counted as progressive. Mateo's involvement was observed without sufficient team-pass rate contrasts to compare passing effects individually. Note that involvement in build-up doesn’t equate to an assist or chance quality, and progression ending in turnovers, as sometimes seen here, doesn’t imply poor decisions given the limited sample.
